name: Taj Mahal
fun_fact: Built of white marble by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

name: Red Fort
fun_fact: The Prime Minister raises the national flag here every Independence Day.

name: Qutub Minar
fun_fact: At about 73 metres it is one of the tallest brick towers in the world.

name: Gateway of India
fun_fact: This giant stone arch stands right on the edge of the Arabian Sea.

name: Charminar
fun_fact: Its name means four towers and it is over 400 years old.

name: Victoria Memorial
fun_fact: A huge white marble hall that is now a museum full of paintings.

name: Statue of Unity
fun_fact: At 182 metres it is the tallest statue in the world.

name: Hampi
fun_fact: The ruins of a great city surrounded by giant round boulders.

name: Hawa Mahal
fun_fact: The Palace of Winds has 953 small windows to let cool breezes in.

name: Mysore Palace
fun_fact: Lit up by nearly 100000 light bulbs on Sundays and festivals.

name: Golden Temple
fun_fact: Its free kitchen serves meals to tens of thousands of visitors every day.

name: Meenakshi Temple
fun_fact: Its tall gate towers are covered in thousands of colourful statues.

name: Konark Sun Temple
fun_fact: The whole temple is carved to look like a giant chariot with stone wheels.

name: Kaziranga National Park
fun_fact: Home to about two thirds of the world's one-horned rhinoceroses.

name: Sundarbans National Park
fun_fact: The largest mangrove forest in the world and home to Bengal tigers.

name: Valley of Flowers
fun_fact: A high mountain valley that bursts with wildflowers every summer.
